children.value: > Fact From Story | Stocks surged through the week on rising hopes that the Federal Reserve is finally done with its market-crunching hikes to interest rates, in order to get inflation under control.
> > Fact From Story | A report on Friday underscored that pressure is easing on inflation after it showed employers hired fewer workers last month than economists expected.
> > > Fact From Story | The market has now switched from pricing in an 80 per cent chance of a rate rise on Tuesday to 50-50, Clark said.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | When the likelihood of a rate hike decreases, the stock market tends to react positively.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | If there is less pressure on inflation, the Federal Reserve is less likely to raise interest rates.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Rising stock prices indicates a boost to shares.
